:warning: triage-bot poll-cycle issues (2026-05-01 17:49 UTC) — 3 infrastructure problems need attention:

*1. Slack blocks-only alerts (7 messages unreadable)*
All 7 messages from bot `B011R3D650X` in `#alert-frontend-errors` use Slack blocks with no plain-text fallback. The MCP returns empty `text` fields. Triage-bot cannot read alert content until the bot adds a `fallback` or `text` field to its payloads. All 7 classified as `needs-human` — consolidated DM sent to Ben.

*2. Git push blocked (403)*
`git push origin main` → `Permission to bgrady-method/triage-bot.git denied to bgrady-method`
GitHub MCP branch creation → `403 Resource not accessible by integration`
Per-message triage branches (`claude/triage-*`) could not be created or pushed. Incident log written locally only.

*3. Investigation credentials not set*
`ELK_BASE_URL` and `DD_API_KEY` are empty. ES/Datadog investigation is unavailable until these are injected into the routine environment.

*Cycle summary:* polled=7, new=7, deduped=0, failed=7 (all failed at git-push step)
